run_kandinsky_img2img_pipeline: run the KandinskyImg2ImgPipeline to generate an image from a prompt and initial image using image embeddings
encode_prompt_with_multilingual_clip: encode a text prompt into embeddings using the MultilingualCLIP text encoder and XLMRobertaTokenizer
prepare_latents_with_noise: prepare image latents by encoding an input image through MoVQ and adding noise at a given timestep
add_noise_to_samples: add noise to original samples using a custom beta schedule with alphas cumprod
compute_timesteps_for_strength: compute the denoising timesteps and adjusted inference steps based on the strength parameter
